name: Negishi Nanana
source:
"Ah... um, I... I'll do... my best..." 

 An introverted girl. She's weak willed, and so can't argue if she's told something strongly. For example, if a guy at a certain school tells her something... 

 Battle quote - "Um, I, ah, here I come!"
[From [url=http://alicesoft.wikia.com/wiki/]Alice Soft wiki[/url]]
